Put the vendor DLLs here. proRFL.dll comes only from the 2019 installer
(【M1中性】D801智能门锁管理系统.exe); the others are also in your CardLock folder:

- proRFL.dll
- Mwic_32.dll
- d12c.dll
- d12.dll
- MFC42D.DLL, MSVCRTD.DLL (debug runtimes the vendor DLLs link against)

They are not committed to the repo.
